primary_endpoint: B: introduced host-by-butterfly-by-region incidences inside the fixed native-known-host resource envelope

constraints.common: Known butterfly-host links and all native ranges fixed; introduction row/column margins within plant family x continent x BIO1/BIO12 tertiles conserved.
constraints.seasonal: Additional within-continent median splits of BIO7 annual temperature range and BIO15 precipitation seasonality; not phenology.

combined_mixing.caution: Only about 5.8% of all focal-host introduction edges differ from their observed positions at the final checkpoint. Tight constraints reduce the inferential scope; agreement of seeds does not prove complete mixing.

claim_boundary: The tested residual remains positive but is very small. Nested-null attenuation is not causal climate mediation; finer constraints partly freeze the randomization space. No conclusion about local larval use, host quality, phenological synchrony, population persistence or biological absence of effects. Do not promote the residual to the manuscript's principal novelty; the +54.9% descriptive expansion is unchanged.
